b2-05-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Evenings at the Hut
b2-05-01.scenario: Ábel is alone in the mountain hut on the Hargita. His father comes up with the cart and asks what Ábel does in the evenings. You are Ábel and answer.
b2-05-01.prompt: Tell your father what you do in the evenings.
cues: Say what you do with old almanacs (leaf through them, slowly)
Say what you do with the wood (arrange it piece by piece)
b2-05-01.target: Esténként régi kalendáriumokat lapozgatok, és a fát rakosgatom.
b2-05-01.english: In the evenings I leaf through old almanacs and arrange the wood piece by piece.
b2-05-01.canDo: I can form and interpret frequentative verbs with -gat/-get and linking-vowel variants (-ogat/-eget/-öget)

b2-05-02.title: Communicative Challenge: By the Hearth
b2-05-02.scenario: Ábel's father asks Ábel how he spends the long winter evenings by the stove in the hut. You are Ábel.
b2-05-02.prompt: Tell your father where you sit in the evenings and what you listen to.
cues: Say that you sit quietly by the stove
Say that you listen to the silence of the forest
b2-05-02.target: Esténként a tűzhely mellett üldögélek, és hallgatom az erdő csendjét.
b2-05-02.english: In the evenings I sit quietly by the stove and listen to the silence of the forest.
b2-05-02.canDo: I can recognize and use the contemplative/leisurely verbal suffix -dogál/-degél/-dögél (üldögél, mendegél, álldogál)

b2-05-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Wind at Night
b2-05-03.scenario: Ábel's father asks whether Ábel was afraid of the noises outside the hut at night. You are Ábel and say what you hear.
b2-05-03.prompt: Tell your father what the wind does outside.
cues: Say what the wind does to the dry branches (repeatedly)
Say how long it goes on
b2-05-03.target: A szél egész este zörgeti a száraz ágakat.
b2-05-03.english: The wind rattles the dry branches all evening.
b2-05-03.canDo: I can contrast a single event (-int/-ant, -an/-en) with its repeated counterpart (-gat/-get, -og/-eg/-ög)

b2-05-04.title: Communicative Challenge: From Generation to Generation
b2-05-04.scenario: On the Hargita, Ábel's father tells Ábel that the forest has been guarded by the Székelys for generations. Ábel answers and says how he is learning the work.
b2-05-04.prompt: Tell your father how the work is passed on, and how you are learning it.
cues: Say that the work passes on from generation to generation
Say that you learn it little by little
b2-05-04.target: Ezt a munkát nemzedékről nemzedékre végezték, én apránként tanulom meg.
b2-05-04.english: This work has been done from generation to generation; I am learning it little by little.
b2-05-04.canDo: I can construct reduplicated case idioms of continuity (nemzedékről nemzedékre, évről évre, szájról szájra)

b2-05-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Day Alone
b2-05-05.scenario: A traveller meets Ábel on the Hargita and asks how his first day alone in the hut went. You are Ábel and tell what you did.
b2-05-05.prompt: Tell the traveller what you did on your first day alone.
cues: Say how you went around the hut at first (afraid)
b2-05-05.target: Először félve kerülgettem a kunyhót, és közben dudorásztam.
b2-05-05.english: At first I went around the hut afraid, and hummed meanwhile.
b2-05-05.canDo: I can orchestrate frequentative (-gat/-get), contemplative (-dogál/-degél), and instantaneous (-int/-ant) verbs within a single narrative

b2-05-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What My Father Taught Me
b2-05-consolidation.scenario: A traveller asks Ábel what life on the mountain is like and what he learned from his father. You are Ábel.
b2-05-consolidation.prompt: Tell the traveller how you spend your evenings and what you learned from your father.
cues: Say what you do by the fire in the evenings
Say that the knowledge passes on from generation to generation
b2-05-consolidation.target: Esténként a tűz mellett üldögélek és lapozgatok. A tudás nemzedékről nemzedékre megy tovább.
b2-05-consolidation.english: In the evenings I sit by the fire and leaf through things. Knowledge passes on from generation to generation.
b2-05-consolidation.canDo: I can accurately form and interpret frequentative (-gat/-get) and contemplative (-dogál/-degél/-dögél) verbs
